_note: casting.json starter (CASTING.md). Fill every <placeholder> (a --go refuses any left), run `casting.py plan`, quote it to the user. Prompts describe what things ARE; never name what must not appear (that pulls the model toward it): such words go in "ban", a build check. Paths are relative to this file; {NAME} expands a snippet from "text" or the built-ins (SHEET, LOCK, KEEP, STATE, FACELESS, GREY, TAIL, PLATE_TAIL, PRE_FACE, PRE_LOC).

text.WHO: a white woman of about 40 with fair skin, short brown hair, grey-blue eyes
text.WARDROBE: a navy work jacket, grey T-shirt, dark jeans, white trainers

state-2.prompt: {STATE} filled in. LEFT panel: a front-facing close-up of the head and shoulders, eyes to camera. MIDDLE panel: the full body from the front, the face area left as a soft plain shadow with no features. RIGHT panel: the full body from behind. {TAIL}

costume.prompt: Image 1 is the locked character sheet. A faceless costume detail sheet: {FACELESS} filled in. {TAIL}

props.prompt: Image 1 shows the world these props belong to. A faceless props sheet: {FACELESS} filled in. {TAIL}

place-1.prompt: An empty location plate, three-quarter view, no people: filled in. filled in. filled in. {PLATE_TAIL}

S01-v1f.prompt: Remove the badge from the jacket. Change nothing else.
